_readme: Load-bearing figures of mexico-invest.com. A figure phrase used in two or more articles is a corpus-wide claim and must be registered here with its source; a figure used once is a local worked example and needs no entry. Entries are grouped per figure: one number can carry more than one meaning ($500 is the low end of the annual fideicomiso fee band and also several unrelated worked-example costs). Adding an entry is a claim about the world, so each needs figure, statement, source and an ISO asOf date. Populated in wave R0; the registry gate arms once coverage reaches 80% of load-bearing figures.
